definitions.explanation: A type of saltwater clam found along the coasts of Japan, China, and Korea. Valued as a food ingredient and culturally significant as a symbol at the Doll Festival.

examples.japanese: ハマグリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ハマグリ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。

⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ハマグリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{吸|す}い{物|もの}→吸い物：04990_suimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a custom of eating clam soup on the Doll Festival.

notes:
Can also be written in kanji as {蛤|はまぐり}, but the katakana form ハマグリ is standard in modern usage, especially in menus, recipes, and everyday writing. The name comes from ⟦{浜|はま}→浜：05041_hama⟧ (beach) and {栗|ぐり} (chestnut), referring to the chestnut-like shape of the shell.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハマグリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: clam miso soup
- ハマグリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{吸|す}い{物|もの}→吸い物：04990_suimono⟧: clear clam soup
- ハマグリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酒蒸|さかむ}し: sake-steamed clams
- {焼|や}きハマグリ: grilled clams

CULTURAL NOTE:
ハマグリ is traditionally served at ⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧ (the Doll Festival, March 3) because each pair of clam shells fits only with its original partner, symbolizing a faithful marriage. The shell-matching game {貝合|かいあ}わせ also uses clam shells.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アサリ→アサリ：10207_asari⟧: short-necked clam — smaller and more common; used in pasta and miso soup
- シジミ: freshwater clam — tiny clams used in miso soup, associated with liver health
